_about: Where the open model plugs in. Pick a profile with active_profile (or --llm-profile / LLM_PROFILE). 'none' runs the agent without any model; every decision is made by plain code either way. All profiles use the OpenAI-compatible chat API, an open wire format that open-source servers (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio) implement. No vendor SDK or orchestration framework is involved.

self-hosted.notes: Placeholder for any self-hosted open model. Serve it with vLLM or SGLang (e.g. vllm serve <weights> --served-model-name local-open-model) and point base_url at the server.

hosted-open-model.notes: Any hosted provider that serves open weights over the same API.
